additional_info.body:
Hi Christian, good morning.
I received a ticket from RC-AT regarding a charger that has wrong documents and wrong configuration in the Outlet section:
First the SCB configuration, for
ALL
outlets, this configuration was enabled:
As you can read here, it says
IF an AC Bauer Meter
is in the charger and even if it was in the charger it's
ONLY for AC
, as such, these configs can never be enabled in DC outlets.
But here is also different case, we don't even have a Bauer Meter, the IP for this device is 10.20.17.40 and when I accessed the charger remotely, I could confirm that we don't have an IP in the network:
Second, the schematic is wrong, it mentions 2 CCS outlets but we have 1 Chademo here:
According to schematic:
Third, on the Technical+data+complete.rtf:
And according to SCB config:
Please align with the colleagues and check why all of these mistakes were done. For the RC, it was very bad experience because no outlets were working right after comissioning.
I will close this ticket since it's not Service related, if you need please reach out to me directly via Teams or reply to this email since I'm in CC.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
